Quality & documentation

The right checks. The right documents. The right shipment.

Export readiness depends on the commodity, supplier, buyer requirements and destination. We keep those transaction-specific requirements connected throughout the sourcing process.

01

Supplier assessment

Relevant suppliers are assessed against product, quantity, packing readiness and the specific buyer requirement.

02

Product alignment

Specification, reference samples, testing or supporting product records can be coordinated where applicable.

03

Documentation

Commercial, origin, customs, transport and product-specific documentation is aligned with the agreed transaction.

04

Packing readiness

Pack format, labelling direction, handling requirements and dispatch preparation are confirmed for the order.
